laps.title: Laps
laps.noPitData: No pit data: the Real Penalty log is missing.
laps.averageHelp: The number in brackets is the number of laps in the average. The average leaves out invalid laps.
laps.cleanHelp: The clean average also leaves out: {{rules}}. Without collector data it cannot see contacts.
laps.theoreticalHelp: The theoretical lap adds the best valid sectors of the driver. It is theoretical: one real lap may not reach it.
laps.chartHelp: Laps slower than {{limit}} stay at the top of the chart. An empty circle is an invalid lap.

title.title: Title fight
title.champion: {{name}} is the champion. No rival can catch them.
title.target_one: {{name}} is sure of the title with {{points}} points in the last round, whatever the rivals do.
title.target_other: {{name}} is sure of the title with {{points}} points in the {{count}} remaining rounds, whatever the rivals do.
title.dependsOnRivals: {{name}} leads, but cannot make sure of the title alone. It depends on rival results.
title.ownDestiny: wins the title if they win every round with pole and fastest lap
title.eliminated: These drivers cannot win the title: {{names}}.
title.maxPoints: One round gives at most {{top}} points (1st with pole and fastest lap). If another driver wins, at most {{second}}.
title.countback: With equal points, more wins rank higher, then more 2nd places, and so on. The same as the standings.
title.noPenalties: The math does not include future penalties.
title.targetHelp: The target assumes that the best rival wins every remaining round. So it is sure, but fewer points can be enough.

limits.rules_changed: The rules changed in the season. The remaining rounds use the current rules.
limits.provisional_results: Some results are provisional. The math can change.

title.empty: It shows after the first race with a result. It shows who can still win the championship and how many points the leader needs.

collectors.title: Collectors
collectors.help: A collector runs next to the AC server and sends the result files and the Real Penalty logs. The files arrive as previews: an admin applies them. Instructions are in collector/README.md.
collectors.keyOnce: Copy it now. The app does not show it again.
collectors.name: Name
collectors.downloadHelp: A zip with the Windows program and a collector.ini with this key. Copy it to the server PC and follow LEEME.txt. Collector already there? You need no zip: copy the key, click the Paddock icon, then “Configurar…”, and paste it.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.help: The Paddock script sends your laps from the league server, with speed, position, and pedals. You install nothing. Here you choose who sees them.
telemetry.protected: Choose “Everything” only if every driver may see your pedals and your steering. Your setup never shows.
telemetry.noInputs: no pedals: the driver does not share them
telemetry.steer: steering: the middle line is straight ahead

compare.title: Compare laps
compare.sign: Difference = B − A. A positive number (+) means that B is slower.
compare.notEnough: At least two valid laps of two drivers are needed.

telemetryLevel.hidden: the driver does not share it

compare.chartHelp: White line: the difference at the same point of the track (by distance, not by time). Above the middle line, B loses time. Color lines: speed of A (blue) and B (yellow). It covers {{coverage}} % of the lap.

gaps.no_laps: This session has no imported laps.
gaps.not_enough_laps: At least two valid laps are needed.
gaps.no_telemetry: No telemetry for both laps: no difference along the track. Sectors only.
gaps.no_map: This track has no map yet.
gaps.different_handicaps: The ballast or restrictor is different. The difference is not only driving.
gaps.different_cars: The cars are different. The difference is not only driving.

health.title: Data health
health.noCollectors: There are no collectors. Rounds are entered by hand.
health.unmatched_one: {{count}} file waits for a round (below, in Collectors).
health.unmatched_other: {{count}} files wait for a round (below, in Collectors).

problems.no_penalty_logs: There are no Real Penalty logs.
problems.collector_stopped: The collector sent nothing that night: it was stopped or offline.
problems.no_events: Files came in, but no UDP event. Check the extra plugin in Content Manager.
problems.partial_events: Partial events: {{lap_events}} laps by UDP of {{laps}} in the file.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.policy: One incident groups the collisions that share a car with less than {{seconds}} seconds between them. A contact of two cars comes twice (once for each car) and counts once.
incidents.mapHelp: Each dot is an incident, at its place on the track. The red areas show where many are. The white line is the track, from the recorded positions.
incidents.mapHelpNoTrack: Each dot is an incident, at its place on the track. The red areas show where many are. Without recorded positions, the map has no track drawing.

engineer.title: Race engineer
engineer.idealGain: {{seconds}} s less, with your best time in each corner
engineer.noPedals: This lap has no pedals: the engineer compares speed only.
engineer.noLaps: The engineer needs valid laps with telemetry in this session. A lap with a cut does not count.
engineer.nothingToGain: You lose no more than 0.04 s in any corner against the reference.
engineer.noCause: The difference has no single clear cause: it is spread over the whole corner. Look at it in the telemetry.
engineer.tableHelp: Time: what you gain (−) or lose (+) in the corner and the straight after it. Braking and Full throttle: meters from the start line where you start to brake and where you are back at full throttle, with the difference in brackets (− is earlier). Minimum and Exit: your speed and the difference with the reference. Gear: yours / the reference.
engineer.spreadText: from {{best}} s to {{worst}} s by lap (deviation {{spread}} s)
engineer.spreadBrake: Your braking point moves about {{meters}} m from lap to lap.
engineer.spreadMin: Your minimum speed moves about {{kmh}} km/h from lap to lap.
engineer.caution: The engineer measures differences, not mistakes. Try one change at a time for a few laps and look at the time of that corner.
engineer.map: Track map with the numbered corners
engineer.mapHelp: Red: you lose time. Green: you gain time. Click a number to see the corner in the table.
engineer.noteFailed: The summary failed. Try again later.
engineer.noAi: The AI is not set up in this app.
engineer.noteHelp: Claude writes a short summary from these numbers. It costs a few US cents, and the app keeps it for this lap and reference.

cause.brake_early: You start to brake {{difference}} m earlier than the reference.
cause.brake_late: You brake {{difference}} m later and reach the apex slower.
cause.brake_soft: You brake softer: {{yours}} % of pedal against {{reference}} %.
cause.min_speed: Your minimum speed is {{yours}} km/h, the reference {{reference}} km/h.
cause.throttle_late: You are back at full throttle {{difference}} m later.
cause.coasting: You go {{yours}} m with no pedal, the reference {{reference}} m.
cause.exit_speed: You exit at {{yours}} km/h, the reference at {{reference}} km/h.
cause.gear: You use gear {{yours}} at the apex, the reference gear {{reference}}.

try.brake_early: Try braking 5 to 10 m later each time.
try.brake_late: Try braking a few meters earlier to reach the apex better.
try.brake_soft: Try a harder first push on the brake, then release it slowly.
try.min_speed: Try releasing the brake earlier and carrying more speed to the apex.
try.throttle_late: Try going back to the throttle earlier, slowly.
try.coasting: Try going from the throttle to the brake with no gap.
try.exit_speed: Try a wider exit and an earlier throttle.
try.gear: Try the gear of the reference.

safety.title: Safety rating
safety.rules: Rules {{version}}: starts at 3.00. +0.01 for each lap, −0.05 for each incident point. Wall 1 point, car contact 2 points for each car, an impact faster than 100 km/h double. Provisional until {{laps}} laps. Points are not blame: steward decisions stay separate.
safety.unknownRound: no collector events: no change (it does not count as a clean race).

replay.title: Position replay
replay.help: A simple replay from the recorded positions, not an AC replay. Between samples less than {{gap}} s apart, the dot moves in a straight line. With more time without samples, the car disappears: it is a gap in the data.

rulesEditor.title: Rules
rulesEditor.summary: Version {{number}}: points {{points}}, pole {{pole}}, fastest lap {{fastest}}. Ballast {{ballast}} kg (max {{ballastCap}}), restrictor {{restrictor}} % (max {{restrictorCap}}).
rulesEditor.recalculateHelp: Not checked: the new rules apply from the next round. Checked: each result of the season gets a new version with these rules.
rulesEditor.confirmRecalculate: This changes the points of every round of the season. Continue?

kinds.protest.decided: Your protest in R{{number}} has a decision
kinds.ballot.reminder: Reminder: you did not vote in {{ballot}} yet
kinds.protest.appeal_decided: Your appeal in R{{number}} has a decision
kinds.collector.no_results: No results: {{championship}} R{{number}} · {{track}}. The collector did not send the race file.

roundTools.cloneHelp: It copies the entries, the current rules, and the fixed tracks (with no date). It does not copy results.
roundTools.conditionsHelp: The drivers see this in the briefing. Leave a field empty to not announce it.

protestExtras.appealReason: Why do you appeal? (one time only)
protestExtras.appealHelp: If you uphold the appeal, change the penalties with the normal tools. If you decided the protest, another person decides the appeal.

classes.title: Car classes
classes.name: Name
classes.emptyText: A class groups similar cars, for example LMDh or GT3.

draw.reasonPrompt: There is already a draw. Why draw again?
draw.poolHelp: Values separated by commas. The draw picks one from each list and a temperature inside each range. An empty list stays out.

pending.title: Pending
pending.images_one: {{count}} track or car without an image
pending.images_other: {{count}} tracks or cars without an image

tabEmpty.incidents: The server collector sent no events for this round. Incidents show when the collector runs during the race.
tabEmpty.replay: The replay uses the positions that the server collector sends. This round has no positions.
tabEmpty.telemetry: Laps show when a driver uploads the telemetry of this round from their collector.
tabEmpty.engineerProfile: The engineer uses your telemetry laps. Choose your driver profile on Home.
tabEmpty.engineerLaps: The engineer gives advice when you upload the telemetry of this round.
tabEmpty.laps: Laps show when an admin uploads the result file of the server.

catalogEdit.name: Name
catalogEdit.help: PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB.
catalogEdit.editTrack: Edit the name and the country

catalogFilter.trackPlaceholder: Search a track, a layout, or a country
catalogFilter.carPlaceholder: Search a car or a brand

strategy.title: Strategy and tyres
strategy.noPitData: Without Real Penalty logs, only a tyre change shows a stop.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.note: Official and provisional results of the seasons you can see count. The incident points come from the collector.

auth.tagline: The league, from the start to the checkered flag.

features.results: Results, lap times, and records of each round

driverScript.title: Script for the drivers
driverScript.help: With this text on the server, AC sends the laps of each driver to the app. Drivers install nothing and open nothing: the script runs inside the game while they are on the server.
driverScript.step1: In Content Manager, open the preset of the league server.
driverScript.step2: Paste this text in the CSP extra options, below the text that is there.
driverScript.step3: Save and restart the server. From phase 4, the server collector does this by itself.
driverScript.confirmNew: The old code keeps working for 6 hours. After that, paste the new text on the server. Continue?

serverPush.title: Send to the server
serverPush.help: The server collector writes this into the Content Manager preset: the drivers with their ballast and restrictor, the track, the announced conditions, and the Paddock script with a new code. It writes only while the server is stopped, and it keeps a copy of the old files. Then start the server in Content Manager.
serverPush.noCollector: The championship has no collector. Make a key in Collectors.

warnings.no_guid: {{name}} has no Steam ID: the slot is not booked.
warnings.weather_kept: The announced weather is not an AC weather name: the server keeps its weather.
warnings.local_address: The app address is local (localhost). The game of the other drivers cannot download the Paddock script, so their telemetry does not arrive. Open the app at its public address, or ask an admin to set PUBLIC_URL.

status.pending: Sent on {{date}}. Waits for the collector.
status.waiting: The collector waits for the server to stop.
status.done: Written on the server on {{date}}. Start the server in Content Manager.

errors.writing_disabled: the collector does not write: write_server_config = false
errors.unknown_preset: the collector does not have that preset
errors.content_manager_open: Content Manager is open. Close it: when it opens again, it reads the new files

serverPush.openSlotsHelp: Empty: {{count}}, the number of the championship. Another number counts only for this push.
serverPush.presetHelp: The collector writes to this preset and uses it from now on. Then start this preset in Content Manager.

delete.league: Delete the league {{name}} with its championships, seasons, rounds, and results? This cannot be undone.
delete.championship: Delete the championship {{name}} with its seasons, rounds, results, members, and collectors? This cannot be undone.
delete.season: Delete the season {{name}} with its rounds, results, and entries? This cannot be undone.
delete.round: Delete round {{number}}? This cannot be undone.
delete.track: Delete the track {{name}} and its layouts?
delete.driver: Delete the driver {{name}}? Their telemetry laps are deleted too.
delete.ballot: Delete the ballot {{name}} with its options and votes?

votes.help: The votes where you can vote. The open ones come first.
votes.emptyText: When an admin opens a vote where you can vote, it shows here and you get a notification.

gameImport.title: Import from the game
gameImport.help: Pick the content folder of Assetto Corsa (inside assettocorsa). The browser reads the cars and the tracks on your PC: it sends nothing yet. Then you choose which to add, and the app makes them with pictures and data. In Firefox, the browser asks if you want to upload the files: accept. It only reads the list.
gameImport.wrongFolder: That folder has no cars or tracks. Pick the assettocorsa folder or its content folder.
gameImport.onlyNew: Only the ones not in the catalog
gameImport.done: Done: {{cars}} new cars and {{tracks}} new tracks, with {{layouts}} layouts.
gameImport.weatherNoDir: The folder «{{folder}}» has no content/weather. If you play on another PC, pick the assettocorsa folder of that PC.
gameImport.weatherNoIni: Found content/weather in «{{folder}}» with {{count}} folders, but none has a weather.ini. ({{detail}})
gameImport.weatherHelp: Chrome and Edge do not let the folder picker read .ini files. If the weather presets do not show, choose only the content/weather folder with this button.
gameImport.weatherNone: That folder has no weather presets (folders with a weather.ini). Choose content/weather.
gameImport.noFiles: The browser gave no files. Pick the content folder again.

calendarOrder.title: Dates of the whole calendar
calendarOrder.help: Drag a round to its place, or use the arrows. Pick the day and time of each one ({{zone}} time). Then Save.

teams.title: Teams
teams.help: The teams of the league. The entry form lists them. Removing a team from the list does not change the entries.

garage.title: Cars and tracks
garage.help: What you can look up before a race: cars with their numbers, tyres and skins, tracks with their layouts, and the weather.
garage.search: Search by name, brand or country
garage.noneText: Try another search, or ask an admin to import the game content.

tyres.relative: Life compared with the longest-lasting tyre of this car
tyres.holds95: Keeps over 95% of the grip up to {{end}} (ends at {{grip}}%).
tyres.drops: Grip under 95% at {{x95}} · under 90% at {{x90}} · under 80% at {{x80}} (the game's wear units).

weather.tempHelp: The coefficient goes from -1 to 1: negative values make the asphalt colder than the weather and the hour say, positive values warmer.

join.title: Join a season
join.help: Choose the season, your car and your number.
join.none: There are no seasons you can join.
join.freeHelp: This season has free join: you are entered at once.
join.requestHelp: This season needs approval: an admin will review your request.
join.requested: Request sent for {{season}}. An admin will review it.
join.freeJoinHelp: With free join, a driver enters alone. Without it, the driver asks and an admin decides.

picker.noneChosen: Drag here or tap + to choose.

optionPicker.title: Ballot options
optionPicker.helpTracks: Tick the tracks of the ballot and untick the ones to remove. The grey ones cannot go in: it says why.
optionPicker.helpClasses: Tick the car classes of the ballot and untick the ones to remove.

why.layout_is_fixed: Already a fixed round of the season
why.grid_too_small: Fewer pit boxes than entered drivers

what.league: The league goes with all its championships, seasons, rounds, results, votes, and teams. The drivers, the accounts, and the catalog stay.
what.championship: The championship goes with its seasons, rounds, results, votes, members, and collectors. The drivers and the catalog stay.
what.season: The season goes with its rounds, results, entries, votes, and rules.
what.round: The round goes with its results, imported files, laps, and report.
what.entry: The entry of the driver in this season goes. An entry with results stays.
what.ballot: The vote goes with its options and votes. Rounds that it added to the calendar stay.
what.driver: The driver profile goes. A driver with an entry in a season stays: remove the entry first.
what.user: The account goes. Its driver profile stays, without an account.
what.track: The track goes with its layouts. A track that a round, a record, or a vote uses stays.
what.layout: The layout goes. A layout that a round, a record, or a vote uses stays.
what.car: The car goes. A car of an entry or a record stays.
what.car_class: The car class goes. The cars stay. A class that a vote uses stays.

errors.in_use: You cannot delete it: it is in use.
errors.entry_has_results: You cannot delete it: the entry has results.

telemetryTool.pickHelp: Click a lap to add it to the chart (up to {{count}}). REF marks the lap that the delta compares with.
telemetryTool.controls: Mouse wheel: zoom · Drag: pick a part · Shift + drag or the bar below: move · Double click: whole lap
telemetryTool.hoverHelp: Move the mouse on the chart or the track
telemetryTool.map: Track map with the chart cursor
telemetryTool.noMap: Without server positions, there is no track map.
telemetryTool.mapHelp: In red: the part on the chart. Move the mouse on the track to move the cursor. Click: zoom to that corner.
telemetryTool.mapHelpCompare: Each part has the color of the fastest lap there. The part on the chart is bright. Click: zoom to that corner.

carDetail.dataError: The data of this car could not be read (data.acd file).

entrySkin.label: Skin
entrySkin.title: Skin for {{car}}
entrySkin.help: Choose the skin you will race with. With "Automatic" the server picks one.
